name: Legacy Sisters
source:
A visual novel like story where technology advanced so quickly that nearly everybody has a personal pet robot - but when a robot rumored to exist in the eighties surfaces resembling a human in every way possible, things get energetic!

[From [url=https://aamp.itch.io/legacy-sisters] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说风格的故事：科技发展得如此迅速，几乎每个人都有一只私人宠物机器人——然而，一台据说在八十年代就已存在、外表与人类完全相同的机器人现身后，事情开始变得热闹起来！

[来源：[url=https://aamp.itch.io/legacy-sisters]itch.io[/url]]
